protocol.note: Budgets are research caps. Early stopping on exhausted search is recorded, not counted as full wall time. Full public regression uses fixed year-5 holdout; different seeds shuffle rows, not independent cohorts.

additional_checks: 28 targeted checks after final cache/gate changes; 2 public-case contract checks.
limitations: Public competition training data; official hidden test labels are unavailable.
Full regression: years 1-4 train (35000), year 5 holdout (18308); seeds shuffle the same cohorts.
Full classification: stratified 80/20 (70136/17534); two independent random splits.
Same time/CPU caps and LLM settings; actual token consumption differs and is reported.
600 seconds is the nominal search budget; production completion grace sets its hard cap to 810 seconds; final fitting has a separate 600-second reserve.
Common final fitting/selection harness, no AutoGluon; not the complete three-hour platform run.
The new mode changes both the research strategy and validation (fixed trees vs outer-fold early stopping).
Earlier sklearn/synthetic grid stopped on user instruction, excluded from these comparisons.
Initial Alfa harness used a strict 600-second timer, unlike production. It was stopped and both modes restarted with production completion grace; those initial runs are excluded.
